outcome: Transfer to the intensive care unit
cohort: 61 patients who underwent cesarean delivery for pernicious placenta previa at the Affiliated Hospital of Zunyi Medical University between December 1, 2012 and November 31, 2017
finding: Regional anesthesia for cesarean delivery in patients with pernicious placenta previa was associated with shorter operation time, less blood loss, fewer transfusions, and lower complication rates compared to general anesthesia.
